name: college-timetable-optimizer
description: College Timetable Optimizer: web app in apps/web, REST API in apps/api. These scripts run them from the repo root.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/api install
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/web run build && npm --prefix apps/api run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/web test && npm --prefix apps/api test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/api run lint
